Message from Chairperson

Mr. Syed Ahsanul Kabir

Message from Chairperson

Welcome to the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at Green University of Bangladesh (GUB).

Started in 2003 as an academic discipline at GUB, CSE Department continues to produce good quality graduates. The CSE department is deeply committed to providing the highest quality undergraduate education. Our courses are up to date and are career-focused to meet the requirements of the IT industry. The CSE faculty members have outstanding academic and research records and they are devoted to our students. “Changing lives…one student at a time” has been the slogan of the CSE department and thus we take special care of you.

The CSE department has started to follow Outcome Based Education (OBE) from Spring 2019 and it offers students many opportunities to expand your intellectual and technical horizons through distinguished lectures, hands-on training, outcome-based laboratory activities, industrial attachments, workplace training, student clubs, programming contests and innovative capstone project development activities. I would like to make a special mention of our unique arrangement of weekly training sessions on solving intelligent programming problems by an ACM world finalist. The final year students and the faculty members of CSE Department are highly contributing to  the International Conference on Sustainable Technologies for Industry 4.0 (STI) organised by the Faculty of Science and Engineering of GUB. We have 9 laboratories with ample opportunities of programming practices, software development, mobile application development, digital logic design, etc.

Sincerity, commitment and timeliness are the main strengths of our department. The faculty members and the students maintain a very congenial and friendly work environment here. Students are engaged in various co-curricular activities and enjoy their stays here.

Information, computing and communication technologies pervade nearly all aspects of today’s digital society and will continue in the decades ahead to be of critical importance to the nation’s technological infrastructure.

We are proud of the accomplishments of our many alumni working for the fastest-growing information technology companies as well as pursuing their high studies in reputed foreign universities with full-funded scholarships. In closing, I hope you will enjoy our website and I am happy to welcome you at CSE premise.

 

Sincerely, and with best wishes,

Chairperson,

Department of CSE,

Green University of Bangladesh.

Natural Language Processing (NLP)

This research cell concentrates on human-computer language interaction, aiming to develop systems that comprehend, generate, and interact with human language meaningfully. Integrating linguistic theories with computational models, the cell addresses syntactic parsing to semantic understanding, bridging the gap between machines and human communication.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does the department follow Outcome-Based Education (OBE)?

Yes. The CSE department has followed the Outcome-Based Education (OBE) curriculum since Spring 2019 to ensure degrees meet international standards.

What is the duration of the B.Sc. program?

The program is designed to be completed in 4 Years .

How many credits is the B.Sc. in CSE program?

The regular B.Sc . in Computer Science and Engineering consists of 144 Credits .

How do I apply for admission?

You can apply online via the GUB Online Admission Portal or visit the Admission Office at the campus in person.
